name: ChoralRoot FM-1 mockups
convention: M-VAVE FM-1: 27 keys F3..G5 addressed by key index 0-26 (MIDI note 53 + index; firmware fm1_in.notes bit n), each with one white LED. 14 buttons by id (FX SEL ENV LFO EDIT GLO / HOME SAVE ARP SEQ PLAY REC, OCT- OCT+), each with an LED (REC red, PLAY orange plus a separate green LED 'playGreen'). LED levels: 0 off, 1 dim (the glow), 2 lit, 3 blinking. 8 rotary controls by id (MASTER pot, SELECT, PRESETS, ALGORITHM, KNOB1..KNOB4 encoders; no push switches) carry text notes. The 240x240 screen is a structured mock-up (header, four knob cards, a panel, a footer) in one of Felucca's eight palettes. Multiple states are alternative pages / layers / moments of the same hardware.
notes: ChoralRoot on the M-VAVE FM-1: a Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument with Felucca's sound engines. The Orchid's 2x4 chord block is the left of the keybed: DIM MIN MAJ SUS on the black keys F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4, 6 m7 M7 9 on the white keys F3 G3 A3 C4 (B3 unused); the 18 keys D4-G5 are the roots. The function buttons carry the Orchid dials' button functions — KEY, PERF, FX, BASS, LATCH, OPT / HOME, SAVE, METRO, LOOP, REC, VIEW (tap = the action, hold = a layer where the root keys and KNOB 1-4 change job and the screen shows how — Felucca's grammar). KNOB 1 is always chord voicing, KNOB 2 bass voicing, KNOB 3 the performance parameter, KNOB 4 the FX amount; PRESETS browses sounds, ALGORITHM the bass sounds, SELECT is the BPM, MASTER the volume. OCT-/OCT+ shift the root keys (and are back / OK in menus). States 1-18 walk through idle, chords, voicing, Key Mode and its layer, the perform layer, an arpeggio, the loop layer, recording, playback, the Options menu, a secret chord, bass and its layer, the fx layer, the Geek Out view, sound browsing, panic, two dial pop-ups, the sound edit pages, the engine picker and saving a sound. Screens follow Orchid's rule — one big thing per screen — in a 1960s mod language: black, white, roundel red and blue, pop yellow, orange and green; flat blocks, stripes and targets; heavy type that squeezes to fit as on the Orchid. Roles: white chords and sounds, blue voicing, orange bass and 7ths, red loop / REC / secret tones, yellow Key Mode, green FX. No menus and no circled numbers: a choice is one item at a time with its neighbours peeking (a picker), a knob value is a huge number over a stripe meter, the idle screen is the name over mod racing stripes. Every state notes its motion.

states.name: 1 · idle (CHORD view)
states.notes: Power-on and idle. No instructions: the name over three racing stripes in the coralroot orchid's colours (red, orange, white) that slide sideways at the master BPM. The chord block is the left of the keybed (DIM MIN MAJ SUS on F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4, 6 m7 M7 9 on F3 G3 A3 C4, B3 unused), the roots are D4-G5. Every key and button glows dim.

keyNotes.0: extensions 6 / m7 / M7 / 9 on the white keys under them: momentary, stackable
keyNotes.1: chord types DIM / MIN / MAJ / SUS on the four black keys: momentary, as on Orchid

buttonNotes.FX: FX: tap = the sound's main effect on/off · hold = fx layer (pick the effect, its parameters)
buttonNotes.SEL: KEY: tap = Key Mode on/off · hold = key layer (root keys pick the tonic)
buttonNotes.ENV: BASS: tap = bass on/off · hold = bass layer (behaviour, register, sound, level)
buttonNotes.LFO: LATCH: Sticky keys / arp hold (a chord keeps sounding after release)
buttonNotes.EDIT: EDIT: tap = enter and exit the sound editor. hold = engine picker, if bass is held with initially entering edit mode, it will edit the bass sound.
buttonNotes.GLO: OPT: tap = Options menu · held + a knob = that knob's second function (Orchid's press + turn)
buttonNotes.HOME: HOME: back to the view from any page, menu or layer · tap again: next View (CHORD / KEYBOARD / NOTES / GEEK OUT / SCOPE)
buttonNotes.SAVE: SAVE: tap = save the sound (Orchid's Sound long press) · hold = save the loop
buttonNotes.ARP: PERF: tap = performance on/off · hold = perform layer (white root keys pick the mode)
buttonNotes.SEQ: METRO: tap = metronome / beat on-off (Orchid's BPM press) · hold = beat picker
buttonNotes.PLAY: LOOP: tap = play / stop · hold = loop layer (slots, sync, quantize)
buttonNotes.REC: REC: tap = record / overdub arm (red) · hold = undo the last layer
buttonNotes.OCT-: octave of the root keys (-2 .. +2); in menus: back / OK · both together: PANIC (all notes off, octave reset)

screen.note: idle: the name over three racing stripes in the coralroot orchid's colours (red, orange, white) that slide sideways at the BPM; the first chord sweeps the stripes off the screen and the chord name lands where the title was.

states.name: Edit Mode
states.notes: Any sound can be opened and edited on the device: Clicking Edit opens the Sound editor which will change the functionality of the function keys and knobs when in it. The Edit LED will flash while in it. For each page section, it will remember it's index. So if OSC section is on page 2, and I switch to filter, and put filter on page 1, if I click to OSC it will still be on page 2, if I then click filter it will still be on page 1. The page tracking and select page group should be remembered and return once I leave the sound editor and come back in.

buttonNotes.EDIT: EDIT: tap = enter and exit the sound editor. hold = engine picker, if bass is held with initially entering edit mode, it will edit the bass sound. Key Flashes while in edit mode
buttonNotes.FX: OSC: Edit the oscillators, keep clicking to cycle through OSC pages. Hold to switch to to OSC2 pages which include individual OSC Levels and envelopes
buttonNotes.SEL: FILT: Filter Pages, keep pressing to cycle the filter pages
buttonNotes.ENV: ENV: Envelope pages, keep clicking to cycle envelope pages
buttonNotes.LFO: LFO: LFO Modulation pages. Keep clicking to switch between LFO pages
buttonNotes.GLO: SHIFT: Hold down shift to fine tune parameters.
buttonNotes.SAVE: SAVE: Open save dialog to save sound
buttonNotes.HOME: HOME: Edit high level synth parameters like transpose, voicing, unison. Click to cycle pages
buttonNotes.ARP: PERF: Works the same as non sound editor

SELECT.value: PAGE: Changes the page and cycles through the section

panel.title: 13 EP
panel.foot: SELECT: page · HOME: done · SAVE: keep it

screen.note: EDIT: a page of four parameters in the knob colours; the glyph of the one being turned animates (the envelope redraws as the knob moves).
